capabilities: Run an interactive shell in an embedded terminal panel
Manage multiple terminal tabs with rename, colors, and pinning
Open terminals at the vault root, current folder, or a right-clicked file or folder
Click file paths and URLs in terminal output to open them
Persist terminal sessions and restore them when Obsidian reopens
extras: Desktop only; requires a one-time download of platform-specific node-pty binaries via a settings button, with troubleshooting steps for ARM64 Windows. Shows a one-time donation pop-up after minor/major updates (disable in settings).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so shell work means switching to a separate terminal window outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Optional Claude Code integration: auto-maintained session registry with clickable Resume links
Install the BRAT plugin if you don't have it

summary: Embedded terminal panel that runs a full PTY shell (PowerShell, bash, etc.) inside Obsidian via xterm.js and node-pty.
